observations: Four ordinary photographs inspected, three showing the lower pedestrian corridor and one showing the side/pier form. Road is above a sheltered full-length side gallery with open river-facing side, solid low parapet and tubular handrail.
A broad concrete roadway/box structure overhangs the lower gallery. Include the real continuous corridor, roof underside, inner red-brown wall and open side; do not substitute an upper sidewalk.
Visible piers have battered stone/concrete faces and large open rectangular portals beneath the superstructure. Include separate bearing ledges, open portals and haunched side beams.
Use shared concrete_plain, stone_granite and metal_painted graphs with metric UVs; no copied graffiti, signage, baked lighting or photo textures.
Source pictures predate some renovation. Modern railings, pole details, surfaces and deck grades remain ordinary-photo approximations.
